title: More flexibility over cssModules pattern
impact: 5 reactions, one 'please prioritize' comment; reporter is a contributor. Use case: truncating long file/class names. Nice-to-have; workaround is a shorter pattern (e.g. drop [name]).
summary: Request for either length modifiers in placeholders ([name:5], [hash:5], [local:4], webpack-style) or a JS function pattern. Today only [name], [local], [hash], [content-hash] parse; anything else is a clear 'unknown placeholder' error.
repro: 491-repro.mjs. 'x-[hash:5]-[local]' -> ERROR unknown placeholder "[hash:5]"; '[hash]-[local:4]' -> ERROR unknown placeholder "[local:4]". Controls: 'w-[name]-[hash]-[local]' -> w-very-long-component-name-module-JfO8bq-navigation-item; '[foo]' errors.

fix.approach: Length suffix ([hash:N], [name:N], [local:N]) is a small, self-contained change in Pattern::parse/write (add an Option<usize> to the segments) and works in all bindings (CLI, wasm, Rust). Truncating [local] can create collisions (.navigation-a/.navigation-b), so [local:N] should probably be refused or documented; [hash:N] reduces uniqueness. A function pattern is larger: it needs napi threading and does not work for the CLI/wasm.

openPRs.assessment: Function pattern ({resolve(hash, path, local, contentHash?)}). Not ready: transform() is synchronous on the JS thread, but the provider calls a ThreadsafeFunction in Blocking mode and then blocks on rx.recv(), which by reading looks like a deadlock (the queued JS call can't run while the JS thread waits); un-gates threadsafe_function from the bundler feature and uses it unconditionally (likely breaks non-bundler/wasm builds); d.ts says `content_hash` but the code reads `contentHash`; no tests; unrelated reformatting in bundler.rs/selector.rs; grid [local]-suffix check is skipped for function patterns (FIXME). Public Rust API change: Pattern becomes an enum (acceptable for the alpha crate, but call it out). Not built or run.

Webpack-parity PR; adds [hash:N] / [algo:hash:digest:N] (covers the hash half only, not [name:N]/[local:N]). Large, with new crypto deps; maintainer was skeptical of the goal. If only truncation is wanted, a small [hash:N] change is simpler.

notVerified: Neither PR was built; the #1262 deadlock is from reading the diff, not from running it.
